title: Khởi tạo repo-map cùng init và thêm lệnh repo-map ngắn
goal: Tạo repo-map an toàn khi khởi tạo project mới và cung cấp public command `repo-map` JSON mặc định để truy vấn cache.
nonGoals: Refresh cache từ platform hook hoặc thêm network, daemon, embeddings hay source persistence.
Thay đổi semantics idempotent của init trên project đã initialized.
Tự stage, commit, push hoặc publish thay đổi.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Fresh init tạo validated repo-map cache và dry-run chỉ báo cache sẽ được tạo; re-init không refresh cache.
Public harnix repo-map --query <text> [--limit <count>] trả tối đa 20 JSON candidates từ cache và xuất hiện trong help; hidden internal commands vẫn tương thích.
PRD, implementation plan, README, changelog và task artifacts ghi đúng public command, init behavior và JSON-default contract.
Package metadata và changelog phản ánh patch 0.6.5 trước completion.

validationPlan.description: Run focused init and repo-map CLI integration tests.
Run typecheck, lint, acceptance, package/tarball/release checks, and diff check.
validationPlan.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:acceptance && pnpm pack:check && pnpm smoke:tarball && pnpm measure:footprint && pnpm scan:release && git diff --check

evidence.summary: RED observed before implementation: focused integration expectations failed because init did not create the repository-map cache and the public repo-map command was absent.
Focused init and repository-map integration tests passed: fresh init creates the cache, dry-run plans it, re-init preserves it, and public plus hidden queries return JSON candidates.

Inspected public command, generated guidance, README, PRD, implementation plan, upstream mapping, and global setup plan. The only remaining --json mentions state that the flag is not needed or must not be added; no command usage retains it.
Package metadata and changelog were inspected and both record patch version 0.6.5 before task completion.
Full gate passed: typecheck, lint, build, all acceptance suites (306 passed, 1 skipped), package check, tarball smoke, footprint, release scan, whitespace check, and the JSON-contract search.
